people.name: Paul Mus
people.field: Southeast Asian cultures, Buddhism, comparative linguistics

relations.subject: Paul Mus
relations.evidence: In 1907 his father opened the College de Protectorate in Hanoi and he would graduate from the college some 12 years later.

relations.subject: Paul Mus
relations.evidence: Mus was a member of The French School of the Far East (French: École Française d'Extrême-Orient, EFEO) since 1927, and "returned to Hanoi in 1927 as a secretary and librarian with the Research Institute of The French School of the Far East until 1940."

relations.subject: Paul Mus
relations.evidence: He later served as a professor at both the Collège de France and Yale University.
